'''Karen Neill''' (born '''Nell Balaban''') is an American voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Pokémon roles==
Neill joined the series at the start of {{aniseries|RS}} and left at the end of [[S08|the eighth season]], when [[Pokémon USA recasting controversy|Pokémon USA took over]] the dubbing and distribution of the series.
